args.summary: Latest production release v2.3.1 of checkout-api failed health checks after deploy. Remedy: rolled back to most recent healthy production release v2.3.0 in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). Rollback verified; service now healthy with error rate 0.002 on v2.3.0. Requires follow-up: investigate root cause of v2.3.1 health check failures before any re-deploy attempt.
